Chapter 6913: Still Want To Run?

Chapter 6913: Still Want To Run?

The grand momentum aspired to end the heaven. In this case, the target was Li Qiye.

“Boom!” Fiery and lightning tribulations engulfed Li Qiye, reaching the level of killing a celestial immortal.

Guangmai and the others were certain this would do significant damage to the mortal. At the very least, the might of the high heaven should be able to suppress him.

“Crackle!” Li Qiye walked out of the explosions as if they were just harmless mist. At best, they left some watermarks on his robe.

“This is it?” He patted his robe and smiled.

“Impossible!” The opponents turned pale.

“These tribulations are not at the celestial level.” Li Qiye said: “You all thought too highly of yourselves. The difference between a primordial and a celestial immortal is an uncrossable ocean of misery.”

Shock turned into despair. This move had used everything they got. They thought this would be more than enough to kill primordial immortals and repel any celestial immortal.

“W-we have to run.” Immortal Devourer trembled in fear. This man might be more monstrous than Immortal Emperor Min Ren.

“Where to?” Fire Immortal asked.

“Doesn’t matter, just have to scatter and hope for the best.” Immortal Devourer said.

Their conversation impacted the other grand immortals.

“Run, try to survive.” Controller agreed.

Since their confidence had been shattered, they no longer wanted to fight.

“Run?!” Guangmai shouted: “Our alliance falls in battle, not run!”

“Your Highness, that will be an unnecessary sacrifice, we must run now.” Controller said.

“We will not give up this heart!” Guangmai burst out in laughter.

“We can’t get it.” God Messenger interjected.

“Let’s leave.” Controller made his decision.

“Leave just like that? Such wishful thinking, I have sworn to get this heart no matter what.” Guangmai said.

“Go.” Controller didn’t care for permission.

“Go!” Others started running.

“It’s too late, today is when I harvest Devouring Alliance. All your lives, dark powers, and essence belong to me alone.” Guangmai declared.

“?!” They didn’t turn back but it was too late.

Guangmai’s staff of authority suddenly shattered to everyone’s horror. This was the unbreakable foundation of the alliance. How could this happen?

The dark powers from the staff flowed toward Guangmai. Dark Light laws also dragged all the fleeing immortals.

“Damn!” They tried to cut it down. Unfortunately, the fusion was unanimously decided by everyone in the alliance.

“All their lives as compensation!” Guangmai turned into a resplendent source of devouring. Other dao runes in Stygian also changed dramatically. A new primordial world seemed to be opening, making way for the vile lifeform.
